product.schneider-n38616-86.summary: The portable IFS advertised in Portugal as the Notebook 386/16–86.
product.schneider-n38616-86.history: In May 1992, distributor IFS presented the Notebook 386/16–86 in the Portuguese newspaper Expresso alongside Schneider desktops.
product.schneider-n38616-86.technical.co: The advertisement photo shows the portable form factor. The board and disk capacity still need to be matched against the German configurations.
product.schneider-n38616-86.technical.ve: The commercial offer is documented. A dedicated model and boot validation in BluMach remain pending.
product.schneider-n38616-86.technical.li: The board still needs identification and an attributed BIOS needs preservation. An image with clear publication rights remains pending.
